newsitem.title: INDIA: India's MMTC tenders to buy 100,000 T urea.
newsitem.headline: India's MMTC tenders to buy 100,000 T urea.

text.p: India's state-run MMTC Ltd has tendered to purchase 100,000 tonnes of urea for arrival during November and December 1996, the company said in a public notice published on Saturday.
The closing time of the tender is 2.30 p.m (0900 GMT) on October 31 and the tender will be valid until 5.30 p.m. (1200 GMT) on November 11, the notice published in the Economic Times newspaper said.
